title: {{NAME}} and the Princess of the Pitch
moral: Everyone deserves a fair chance to play, no matter who they are.

pages.content: {{NAME}} arrived at the castle soccer field. The grass was very green and the goals were made of gold. A big game was about to start. But one team had no goalkeeper. Everyone looked around. Nobody wanted to play in goal.

pages.content: A girl walked onto the field wearing a sparkly pink gown and a crown. She had a soccer ball under her arm. Her name was Princess Mira. She smiled at {{NAME}}. "I will play if you play too!" she said.
